title.narrative: In 2025, UNICEF strengthened education system resilience by translating evidence into policy dialogue, scaling climate-smart education, and sustaining learning continuity in crisis settings. National research and evaluation frameworks progressed, climate-smart approaches reached thousands of schools, and over 3,200 children affected by conflict accessed learning support - strengthening system preparedness amid climate and security risks.
